passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My dad is my hero, and he is strong and brave.
He goes to work every day, and he tries hard.
phrases.ko: 아빠는 매일 일하러 가고, 열심히 해요.

phrases.en: He keeps us safe at home.
phrases.ko: 아빠는 집에서 우리를 안전하게 지켜 줘요.

phrases.en: I am proud of him, and I love my dad.
I want to be like my hero.
His work at the hospital helps sick people.
phrases.ko: 병원에서 하는 아빠의 일은 아픈 사람들을 도와요.

phrases.en: He is brave, but he is also gentle.
Every day he comes home and smiles.
phrases.ko: 아빠는 매일 집에 와서 미소를 지어요.

phrases.en: I feel safe when he is near.
A strong dad can still be kind.
I love my hero very much.

full_passage_spoken: My dad is my hero, and he is strong and brave. He goes to work every day, and he tries hard. He keeps us safe at home. I am proud of him, and I love my dad. I want to be like my hero. His work at the hospital helps sick people. He is brave, but he is also gentle. Every day he comes home and smiles. I feel safe when he is near. A strong dad can still be kind. I love my hero very much.
